title: Bloom
statement:
Bloom A jellyfish-inspired audiovisual motion sculpture by Melis Ragusin, shaped by the philosophy of impermanence and the fluid escape paths of Deleuze’s ligne de fuite. Bloom is a sculptural video loop that captures the quiet intelligence of jellyfish — their soft unfolding, slow breath-like rhythm, and constant transformation. Drifting through soft wine hues and pastel tones, the central form opens and closes in motion that never fixes — only becomes. Inspired by the Deleuzian idea of the line of flight, this work meditates on emotional presence through fluidity, letting softness become a form of escape and renewal.
